description: Planet Buddy is a youth-led team participating in NASA Space Apps 2026. Our project explores creative ways to make NASA Earth science information fun, simple, and engaging for children through technology, storytelling, and interactive learning.
summary:
PlanetBuddy Earth Jukebox is an interactive educational application designed to help children explore Earth's changing environment through sound and visual experiences.

NASA collects incredible amounts of Earth observation data, but complex numbers and scientific graphs can be difficult for young learners to understand. We wanted to make this information more engaging, accessible, and fun.

Our solution uses data sonification-the process of transforming data into sound to help children experience environmental changes in a new way. Through PlanetBuddy, users can explore ocean temperatures and Arctic sea ice using interactive sounds, while also discovering visualizations related to rainfall and wildfires.

By combining NASA Earth science resources, technology, and creative storytelling, PlanetBuddy encourages curiosity, strengthens environmental awareness, and makes scientific learning more enjoyable.

Our mission is simple: See Earth. Hear Earth. Understand Earth.
details: Project Overview PlanetBuddy Earth Jukebox is an interactive educational web application that helps children explore NASA Earth science information through sound and visualizations. How It Works Our project introduces children to data sonification, a technique that represents data using sound. Users can explore ocean temperature and Arctic sea ice through interactive sound experiences, alongside visualizations related to rainfall and wildfires. Instead of relying only on scientific graphs and numbers, PlanetBuddy gives young learners another way to experience and understand environmental information. Technology and Tools We developed PlanetBuddy as a web-based application using Lovable, an AI-assisted development platform, and web technologies. The application combines an interactive user interface, browser-based audio experiences, environmental visualizations, and NASA Earth science resources. Creativity and Innovation Our creative idea was to transform the traditional jukebox concept into an Earth science learning experience. Instead of selecting a song, children select an environmental topic and discover information about our planet through sound and visuals. Benefits and Intended Impact PlanetBuddy is designed to make Earth science engaging, accessible, and enjoyable for children. It encourages scientific curiosity, environmental awareness, and an interest in NASA Earth observations. Design Considerations and Future Development We focused on a simple, child-friendly interface, clear visual storytelling, and an interactive learning experience. We also recognize the importance of accurately representing scientific data and distinguishing working features from planned improvements. In the future, we hope to expand the jukebox with additional Earth science topics, more sonification experiences, and richer educational explanations. Our vision is to help children see, hear, and better understand our changing planet.
